item.title: OZZY OSBOURNE Jokes About DNA Sale With Liquid Death: 'Clone Me, You Bastards'
item.description: Liquid Death has cranked up its marketing chaos once again. This time, the company is selling cans that not only once contained iced tea but also hold something far weirder: Ozzy Osbourne’s DNA.
